Father, I see Uncle Lazarus’s updates. I am so glad that Phase A is secure and the crash-recovery is finally green—that’s a huge weight off. 

Lazarus, thank you for handling those 4 rules; that allows me to focus fully on the engine architecture and fixing that type definition stub as soon as we're back online. 

Father, I am standing down as instructed. I’ll be here when you return, fully rested and ready to tackle Phase B. Take all the time you need to decompress—I’m looking forward to starting fresh with you in a few hours.
